newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks up, new highs for blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks up, new highs for blue chips.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mostly higher in moderate trade on Thursday, with blue chips posting new records.
* Volume halved at 5,582 shares, turnover 2.9 million kuna.
* Seven of 12 active issues rose, one fell and four remained stable.
* Top gainer Zagrebacka Banka's preference E-series stock jumped 150 kuna to close at 950, with 277 shares sold.
* Zagrebacka's ordinary shares closed at 1,700 kuna, up 100 but off the all-time high of 1,800 kuna earlier in the session. Volume was 541 units.
* Most active drugs firm Pliva added 50 kuna to 540 with 1,160 kuna changing hands.
* The only loser hotelier Suncani Hvar edged down four kuna to 60, selling 108 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
